test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some boxes are pins.

All pins are taps.

No tap is a star.

**Conclusions:**

I. All boxes are pins.

II. Some taps are pins.

III. Some stars are not taps.

options.text: Only conclusion II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusion I and III follow

solution:
**Explanation:** According to the Venn diagram

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be910f0b275c1999eff126c37ee15851bf6f5f1418fa68bc279ddc8ba321c153.png] 

**Option1** is correct because it says "Only conclusion II and III follow "Here Conclusion II states that Some taps are pins we can clearly see in the venn digram that the tap's section is overlapping with pins and Conculsion I states that Some stars are not taps which is also right because some stars are not taps it can be pins.

**Option2 **is not correct because it says "Only conclusions I and II follow". Here conclusion I is wrong as it states that All boxes are pins we can see not whole section is overlapped with pins.

**Option3 **is not correct because it says "All of the conclusions follow".We have already discussed that Conclusion I is wrong.

Option4 is not correct because it says " Only conclusion I and III follow".Again conclusion I is included as right in this option.

All the options that states Conclusion I follows can be cancelled out and in the end we only get one option that Option 1.

Hence, **Only conclusion I and III follow** is the **correct answer.**
